{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
df_dedup = df.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

total_patients = len(df_dedup)
severe_patients = df_dedup['severity'].eq('severe').sum()
fraction_severe = severe_patients / total_patients

# Print only the required numbers
print(total_patients)
print(severe_patients)
print(fraction_severe)"}
